_note: Hosts here are manually verified via WebFetch or browser. `hosts` = block HEAD/GET with 403/429 (bot-blocked). `certErrorHosts` = real sites that fail Node's strict TLS (self-signed chain or older CA), reachable in browsers. In both cases the verify script emits a warning rather than an error. `knownDownHosts` = hosts that refused connections from multiple networks on the date noted; the verifier warns instead of failing so unrelated deploys are not blocked. Re-check them and remove the entry (or fix the accelerator URL) once they are back.
